title: manuscript-guard sign-off
description: A named person's sign-off of a finding only they may close, bound to what it said: the digest of the findings and of what they are about, a model's card for a G15 warning. Written by `manuscript-guard sign --as <person> --finding <id>`, one file per finding under approvals/sign-offs/, and never by an agent: a sign-off is a person's statement. The finding is then reported as information that names who signed it; a sign-off of something that has changed since, or by someone who no longer holds the role, counts for nothing.

finding.description: The id the finding's hint names, such as G15/model-few-events/adjusted.

person.description: The person's name as authors.yaml gives it.

signed_sha256.description: What was signed: the findings' messages and what they are about.

said.description: The findings as they read when signed, for whoever reads the file.

note.description: Anything the person says with the sign-off, why it is acceptable included.
